chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abi Basir, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:

When you enter the privy, then say: I seek refuge in Allah from the impure, filthy, wicked, corrupting Satan, the accursed. And when you finish, then say: All praise is for Allah, who has granted me well-being from affliction and removed harm from me.

key_terms.أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ: I seek refuge in Allah for protection
key_terms.الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: praise and gratitude belong to Allah

ai.seo_question: What should be recited when entering and leaving the toilet according to a hadith in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches prescribed du'a for entering and leaving the place of relieving oneself. It combines seeking refuge from Shaytan before entering with gratitude to Allah after finishing, reflecting the etiquette of ritual purity and remembrance of Allah in daily acts.
